verdict.rationale: Gram ships an official platform MCP server. From Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another MCP client, an org admin can manage the platform in natural language without opening the dashboard. Documented operations include adding and configuring MCP servers, managing plugins and distribution, authoring skills, managing access roles and risk policies, reviewing shadow servers, configuring telemetry and reading observability data. A one-line Claude plugin install supports this, though the in-dashboard agent harness only covers chatting with MCP server tools for testing. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as documented, and no built-in natural-language interface for managing the platform (it relies on an external MCP client).
